text: Gezan is a rare warp stalker found near the river in the southern part of the Irontree Woods in Felwood.
__NOTOC__ General Rik-Rik Jr is a hozen located in Fox Grove in the Jade Forest.

Gennadian is found inside a small pit in the Gordal Fortress of southeastern Talador. Dodge the fire beams and the pools of fire! Loot Gennadian for the Scales of Gennadian and 20-30x Garrison Resources.
General Lizzie Heartbane is a prisoner of the Alliance, found in the basement of Stormshield Stronghold in Ashran.
Gerp's Perfect Arrow is a random world drop from Pandaria mobs.
Gently Squeezed Toad can be bought from Old Loola or picked up in the surrounding swamp. Giving the Belly Toads a light squeeze will produce Vial of Toad Juice.
Generous Dan was not captain of the Dread Crew for long, but is still regarded as the best captain ever.
General Volroth is an annihilan located at the Soul Engine on Mardum.
Gerard Loom is a forsaken follower located at Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. He can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Frostwall Tavern.
Genn Greymane's Coin is fished from the fountain in Dalaran at the Broken Isles.
Geyah is the orcish Lorekeeper of the that reside in in . She is the mate of and her son is . She has a wolf companion named Singer.
Get In My Belly! is an achievement earned from killing Gorefiend in after killing the Soul of the Crone on Normal Difficulty or Higher.

A generic name is the name with which an NPC who follows a certain player can appear to other players. While the player who is being followed sees the NPC under their proper name (for example "Archmage Modera"), other players will see the NPC under a generic name ("Kirin Tor Conjurer"). Their appearance is also often altered for other players. This is seemingly done to preserve immersion by preventing multiple copies of the same character from existing at the same time.

Getting the Kinks Out sends leatherworkers back to Celea to learn more about mail armor at level 104 and having completed her previous quests. However, if you are already above that level when you turn those in, she will offer the next set. In that case, this quest would be optional.

General Startalon was one of the finest generals the night elves of Suramar have ever known. He commanded the hippogryph riders during the War of the Ancients. His tomb is in Tel'anor. It was often visited by Thaedris Feathersong to meditate for guidance.
__NOTOC__ Gerdes the Drowsy is a night elf innkeeper located at the Wileywisp Den, on top of Sabermaw Bluff in Val'sharah.

__NOTOC__ General Tel'arn is a night elf located in the Chamber of War at Black Rook Hold. He was one of the greatest heroes during the War of the Ancients, but after being risen, his failures had driven him insane. Heroes are sent in by Rensar Greathoof to grant him eternal rest.
George Krstic is Director of Story, Creative Development, at Blizzard Entertainment. As leader of the Story team, he takes part in many aspects of storytelling, including cinematics.
General Erodus is an eredar brute located at the Gaze of the Legion in Antorus, the Burning Throne.
Geosculptor Yip is a kobold found underground. She can change the earth around her to create formidable opponents.
Gentle's Spellbook is a book located at Fallhaven in Drustvar.
General Harris is a Forsaken located on board the Horde gunship in the Seething Shore.

Overlord Geya'rah is the daughter of and from the alternate Draenor. She served as Warchief Grommash Hellscream's second-in-command during the War between the Lightbound and the Mag'har. She now leads the Mag'har orcs who managed to escape from Draenor, and pledged her people's loyalty to Sylvanas Windrunner and the Horde. Unlike most leaders, Geya'rah supported the increasingly hostile actions of Sylvanas Windrunner during the Fourth War. This led to her standing as a loyalist when the Horde rose up in rebellion against her, though she would ultimately come to regret this decision after Sylvanas abandoned the Horde. Quickly shifting her allegiances, Geya'rah admitted her mistake. As such, G
Gentle Goats are goats located in the Westwind Weald in Tiragarde Sound.
The Getaway Boat is a boat located on the north-eastern shore of Tol Dagor. The boat is steered by Taelia.

Get Hek'd is an exploration achievement earned for completing tasks for Jani in various locations throughout Zandalar. In order to gain access to Jani's quests and turn-in items, players must first complete the two prerequisite quests Pests and Curse of Jani. Upon completion of this achievement, a chest spawns in Dazar'alor allowing Horde players to find Clump of Broken Loa Idols.

Gentle Guntha is a skeletal troll sitting on top of a large pillar in the northeastern Port of Zem'lan in Vol'dun. He is one of the few non-hostile inhabitants of the port and offers the player a drink from his peace offering, which is sitting next to him.
Geti'ikku, Cut of Death drops from King Dazar in Kings' Rest.

General Krathax is a sethrak who appears at or in the Blistering Wastes in Vol'dun while the world quest Azerite Mining (Vol'dun) is available. He is seen using a group of Vulpera Slaves to mine a large :Azerite crystal, and he appears to be the leader of the Faithless' Azerite mining operations in the area.
Gersho is a tortollan located in Gral's Grotto in Zuldazar. After Rastakhan's death in the Battle of Dazar'alor, he was present at his funeral in Dazar'alor.
General Zhun was a mogu set to appear in the Temple of Kotmogu scenario.
General Blackstone is a Forsaken located in Warfang Hold in Stormsong Valley during Eye for an Eye (Stormsong Valley).

__NOTOC__ General Huxzar is a night elf who served Queen Azshara and killed Professor Elryna when she showed him her research on the creation of snapdragons. His subsequent fate is unknown. The vision of this event was discovered by Collector Kojo and an adventurer in Nar'anan in Nazjatar.
General Xing is a Rajani mogu who patrols inside the Silent Sanctuary in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Genji is a wolf pup occasionally summoned by Finduin. It is a reference to Genn Greymane.
The Germinating Seed drops from rares or is found in chests in Nazjatar. At in the Coral Grove, plant the seed in the Fertile Soil to spawn the Carnivorous Lasher.

Gersahl Greens is a leaf of Gersahl Shrubs located in Uldum. If Friendly Alpaca is fed with it seven times, it will offer a quest to immediately receive Reins of the Springfur Alpaca. It can be fed once per day, and you do not need to feed it in 7 consecutive days to earn the mount.
Gersahl Shrubs are plants found all along Vir'naal River in Uldum. They contain Gersahl Greens.
__NOTOC__ Geolord Grek'og is a quilboar located at the Quilboar Briarpatch in Exile's Reach.
General Vartox is a Stoneborn servant of The Tithelord. She is located in a basement in Stonevigil Overlook in Revendreth. Here she is found with three Stonevigil Citizens.
__NOTOC__ Gerdus is a kyrian located in Firstborne's Bounty in Bastion.

General Draven is a stoneborn of Revendreth. He wishes to restore Revendreth to its rightful purpose, and as a result, became a loyal companion to Prince Renathal. He still sees other stoneborn as his siblings, even those who wish to kill him.

Gentle Clefthooves are clefthooves located in Southwind Cliffs and Grom'gar in Frostfire Ridge. The ones at Grom'gar are observed and targeted by a Iron Siegecaller who signals Iron Cannoneers to fire at the beasts from Iron Siege Cannons.
The sinstone of General Dugall is found in Revendreth in the Archivam, in the area behind the manor.
General Alver is an abomination leading the House of Constructs forces at the Spearhead in Maldraxxus. Secutor Mevix describes him as a master tactician. __NOTOC__
Genghis is an abomination located in the Stitchyard in Maldraxxus.

Gertie Jr. is a silkstrider larva first seen atop the Gossamer Cliffs in Ardenweald, near her dead mother Ol' Gertie. After adventurers kill Noisul of Many Faces, they carry Gertie Jr. back to the safety of Caretaker Lillythistle's cave. Lillythistle then asks the heroes to take the larva to the Heart of the Forest, where she will perhaps grow up to be as grand as her mother. Gertie Jr. can subsequently be found on the Trunk level inside the Heart of the Forest. __NOTOC__

General Grashaal is a stoneborn located in Revendreth. He is apparently very old as far as stoneborn go, shown by his size and long beard. General Draven claims that, once Draven joined Prince Renathal's rebellion, Grashaal was animated in order to replace him. He is first seen in The Master Awaits where he discusses the fate of Renathal's rebellion, is fought during The Master of Lies, and is ultimately killed in the penultimate encounter of Castle Nathria. He is part of the Stone Legion Generals encounter in Castle Nathria.
Get to the Point is a potential quest of the Necrolord Assault on Perdition Hold.
General Erodus' Tricorne drops from the Antoran High Command in Antorus, the Burning Throne.
Genuine Deathwing Fang is a quest reward from The Day that Deathwing Came: What Really Happened.
Geomancy Slicer drops from Forgemaster Throngus in Grim Batol.
Gently Gnawed Hauberk drops from Beauty in Blackrock Caverns.
Genesis Crawler is a tarachnid mount created with Protoform Synthesis; taught by Schematic: Genesis Crawler.
Genesis Motes drops from most mobs throughout Zereth Mortis, is rewarded from A New Architect, and can be obtained from Olea Cache. It is the main ingredient in Protoform Synthesis.
__NOTOC__ General Zarathura is a nathrezim located at the Dread Portal in Zereth Mortis.
__NOTOC__ Genesis Guardians are automa located at the Genesis Vestibule in Zereth Mortis. One is found within the Genesis Alcove as well.
Gestation Helpers are automa located in the Gravid Repose in Zereth Mortis. Some occasionally venture out into the Resonant Peaks.
Genesis Fields Report is provided by the Knight of the Ebon Blade at the edge of the Genesis Fields in Zereth Mortis.
Generous Gift is looted from Polemarch Adrestes' Substantial Tribute and Polemarch Adrestes' Extravagant Tribute in the Ember Court.
Generic Deities are souls brought back to life through the use of Wildseeds of Regrowth in the Queen's Conservatory.
Genesis Lathe drops from Lihuvim in Sepulcher of the First Ones.
__NOTOC__ Generated Automentals are geomentals located in the Plain of Actualization in Zereth Mortis.
__NOTOC__ Generated Bulwarks are automa located in the Plain of Actualization in Zereth Mortis.
Generated Dire Vombata are vombata located in Plain of Actualization in Zereth Mortis.
Generated Oracles are automa located in Plain of Actualization in Zereth Mortis.
Generated Shapesmiths are automa located in the Plain of Actualization in Zereth Mortis.
Geribald Crooke is a Forsaken located in the Ruins of Lordaeron in Tirisfal Glades. He is sitting next to Nem Shelley.
Gentara is a bakar sitting next to Beastmaster Nuqut on the southwestern outskirts of Timberstep Outpost in the Ohn'ahran Plains.
Get In Formation is a soulbind trait granted by Korayn. It is exclusive with Vorkai Sharpening Techniques.
General Trade is a general goods shop found in the Craftsmen's Terrace in Darnassus.
The Generous Goblin Grenade drops from goblins on the Dragon Isles.
Gertzvelt the Watchful is a bronze drakonid located at the Cascades in Thaldraszus. He keeps an eye on things as Theri entertains a group of Playful Children.
Geradran is a dracthyr located at Algeth'ar Academy in Thaldraszus.
Getseng is a centaur of Clan Aylaag located by the western entrance to Maruukai in the Ohn'ahran Plains.
Geyserwalker Bindings are a quest reward from Storm Chasing.

Get Your Own Dragon was an ad campaign for which featured an augmented reality experience to view the new dragons part of the dragonriding experience in real life. It has since been taken down after the expansion's release date. A video advertising the experience was published on YouTube which features , , and .
Geyser Flowers are found throughout Ohn'ir Geysers in the Ohn'ahran Plains. Windsage Boku wants eight in Optimistic Mystic, part of the Old Hatreds storyline.
__NOTOC__ Gethrel the South Wind is a proto-dragon located in the Ohn'ahran Plains.
__NOTOC__ Gethdazr is a proto-dragon located in the Azure Span.
Getting to the Point becomes available after reaching Renown 17 with the Maruuk Centaur.
General Chartrue is a green dragonspawn located in Shady Sanctuary in the Ohn'ahran Plains.
General Zskorro is a rare black dragonspawn located in a buidling on the west side of Brimstone Garrison in Zaralek Cavern.
Generations of Gemstones I is a profession achievement earned by crafting 100 items with the Jewelcrafting profession.
Generations of Gemstones II is a profession achievement earned by crafting 1000 items with the Jewelcrafting profession.
Generations of Gemstones III is a profession achievement earned by crafting 5000 items with the Jewelcrafting profession.
Generations of Gemstones IV is a profession achievement earned by crafting 15000 items with the Jewelcrafting profession.
Geologist's Ledger - Draconium is a profession achievement earned by discovering and documenting every variant of Draconium found on the Dragon Isles.
Geologist's Ledger - Serevite is a profession achievement earned by discovering and documenting every variant of Serevite found on the Dragon Isles.
Geologist's Ledger: Dragon Isles is a profession achievement earned by documenting all of the exciting mining discoveries found across the Dragon Isles.
Gerald is an achievement reward from Family Battler of Zaralek Cavern.
Geode Splinters is contained in Stormed Primalist Cache, Disturbed Dirt, Chest of the Elements, and Expedition Scout's Pack.
Geyserwalker Visage is a quest reward from The Nokhud Offensive: Founders Keepers.
Gently-Used Cleaver is available for purchase from the Trading Post for 50 Trader's Tender. It was first available in September 2023.
Get on the Horn becomes available after reaching Renown 23 with the Maruuk Centaur.

== Profile == George Warner is a senior Developer Technical Support (DTS) engineer at Apple Computer, Inc. where he's currently responsible for multi-tasking/processing (threading), performance, vectorization and games.
Ghost Mushroom is an herb that can be gathered with Herbalism (245).

Ghostlands is the third original English manwha written by Richard A. Knaak and drawn by Kim Jae-Hwan of The Sunwell Trilogy. It was released on March 13, 2007 in the US [http://www.amazon.com/Warcraft-v-3-Kim-Jae-Hwan/dp/1595327142/sr=11-1/qid=1168203008/ref=sr_11_1/026-9154132-9077210] and February 28, 2007 in Canada [http://www.amazon.ca/Warcraft-v-3-Kim-Jae-Hwan/dp/1595327142/sr=11-1/qid=1168203008/ref=sr_11_1/026-9154132-9077210]. *1-The Nightmare Plains *2-Master of the Dead *3-Cry of the Banshee *4-Dark Reunion *5-Edge of the Abyss *6-Fire and Fury

Ghouls are undead acting as the shock troops for the Scourge. These lumbering, rotting corpses were once innocent townsfolk who have made the final transition into true undeath. Ghouls have great stamina and revel in combat with living beings. Ghouls are ravenous cannibals who can replenish their health by devouring the flesh of fallen warriors, friend and foe alike. Ghouls are found in several places throughout Azeroth, primarily the Eastern Kingdoms and Northrend. Most notable are those who terrorize the Plaguelands as the front lines of the Scourge. Heavy concentrations can also be found in Eversong Forest and Ghostlands. Mindless ghouls can also be found in Silverpine Forest and Duskwood

Ghost Walker Post is a small tauren outpost established in central Desolace directly adjacent to the Kodo Graveyard. It is one of two Horde outposts in the region, though Ghost Walker Post is much more exposed to danger compared to Shadowprey Village and its relatively secure location. It is from Ghost Walker Post that the Horde wages its war on the Burning Blade and their servants in Desolace as well as the various centaur tribes. The leader of Ghost Walker Post is Gurda Wildmane, a tauren shaman. Gurda and the other shamans ease the nearby kodo into their next lives and sometimes communicate with the spirits of dead kodo. There is also a contingent of orcs here, sent by Thrall. Ghost Walke
Ghostly Strike is a tier 3 talent in the rogue's Subtlety tree and gives a lightweight Evasion designed for more regular use.
Ghamoo-Ra is an elite turtle mini-boss found in the Pool of Ask'ar of Blackfathom Deeps.
__NOTOC__ Ghost Dye is a component used by Tailors to create special high level cloth items.

Giant clams are sea creatures found on the sea floor. They are different from regular clams in that they can only be opened and have their contents removed. The giant clams themselves cannot be picked up. Giant clams contain different items depending on the zones they are picked up in. *Giant clams in Blackfathom Deeps drop Tangy Clam Meat and a chance of dropping Iridescent Pearl. *Giant clams in Northern Stranglethorn will drop Giant Clam Meat.

Ghost Sabers are cats found in Darkshore. They are unique in having a transparent look that makes them look stealthed. Ghost Sabers will occasionally be summoned when Cat Figurine statuary objects are opened. Ghost Sabers are also the only tamable cats using the special ghost cat model.

Ghok Bashguud is rare mob orc found in Lower Blackrock Spire. He is located in the room before the bridge to Overlord Wyrmthalak's room, up the stairs from Halycon's lair, and can be found sleeping in a corner with two sleeping guards.
Ghost Howl is a wolf found roaming the plains around the base of Thunder Bluff in Mulgore.
__NOTOC__ Ghak Healtouch is a dwarf artisan alchemy trainer located inside a dwarven house behind the Thelsamar inn in Loch Modan.
__NOTOC__ Giant Buzzards are vultures found in the Badlands.
Ghaz'an is an hydra boss of the Underbog in Coilfang Reservoir.
Giant Silver Veins drop from Cliff Walkers, Cliff Thunderers, and Cliff Breakers in Azshara.
Ghostly Mantle is a quest reward from Deathstalkers in Shadowfang.
Ghostshroud is a Level 51 quality Leather Hood that improves Agility, Stamina and Haste.
Giant Darkfang Spiders are tarantulas found in Dustwallow Marsh.
Giant Plains Creepers are tarantulas found in the Arathi Highlands.
Giant Ashenvale Bears are brown bears found in eastern Ashenvale.
Ghostpaw Howlers are wolves found along the eastern side of Falfarren River in Ashenvale.
Ghostpaw Runners are wolves found in northwestern Ashenvale. Unlike most beasts, Ghostpaw Runners are capable of fleeing.
__NOTOC__ Giant Ember Worgs are worgs found in eastern Burning Steppes.
Ghostclaw Lynxes are lynxes found in central and eastern Ghostlands. When tamed by a hunter, they possess the skill Claw 2. They can also be found as pets to Shadowpine Catlords.
Ghostclaw Ravagers are lynxes found in the Ghostlands. When tamed by a hunter, they possess the skills Bite 3 and Claw 3.
Ghermas is a draenei located at the Trader's Tier in the Exodar. During the Battle for the Exodar, she was inside Velen's protective shield.
Ghoul Fingers dropped from Leprithus in Westfall prior to Cataclysm. It is now available again via Big Crate of Salvage.
Ghamoo-Ra's Bind is a cloth belt that drops from Ghamoo-Ra in Blackfathom Deeps.
__NOTOC__ Ghostly Philanthropists are human ghosts located in Opera Hall in Karazhan and the Return to Karazhan.

Gezhe is an ethereal quest giver located at Aeris Landing in Nagrand. He is a Consortium merchant responsible for locating Aeris Landing closer to Oshu'gun because he predicted a 10% increase in profits by doing so. He is ordered not to mine Oshu'gun but comes up with a loophole that will allow him to take shards that the rogue ethereals in the area have harvested. Gezhe keeps up to date with ethereal trade dealings through the means of a Consortium Nether Runner. He is also interested in the valuable obsidian beads that the ogres wear in Nagrand and will ingratiate those who supply him with the Consortium. He accepted to take the draenei orphan Jheel as a gemcutter apprentice for the Consor
The Ghoul Skin Leggings drop from the following bosses in Scholomance: *The Ravenian *Doctor Theolen Krastinov *Lord Alexei Barov *Instructor Malicia *Lorekeeper Polkelt *Lady Illucia Barov
__NOTOC__ Ghede is a tauren located in Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff.
Ghabar is an ethereal quest giver located at the Stormspire in the Netherstorm.
Ghoul Rib drops from the following ghouls in Duskwood: *Plague Spreaders *Brain Eaters *Bone Chewers *Rotted Ones *Flesh Eaters
Giant Clam Scorcho is created by Cooking (175); taught by Recipe: Giant Clam Scorcho.
Ghost-o-Plasm drops from Magrami Spectres in Desolace when they die near the Crate of Ghost Magnets.

Gezzarak the Huntress is one of four descendants of Terokk's ancient enemies who are being held prisoner by the Skettis talonpriests. You learn of their existence from a tome named Adversarial Bloodlines. Originally, you were asked to retrieve Gezzarak's Claws if you intended to summon and defeat Terokk. Open a skull pile at one of the red summoning portals in Skettis. If you have 10 Time-Lost Scrolls, you will be presented with a list of names. Select "Gezzarak the Huntress". The scrolls will be expended and Gezzarak will appear in a flash of lightning.
Gezzarak's Fang drops from Gezzarak the Huntress in Terokkar Forest.

This is a list of all Ghostlands quests in table format. For a questing guide detailing the best order to obtain and complete quests in Ghostlands, see Ghostlands questing guide. Delivery to Tranquillien introduces the young Blood Elf players to this region.

Gharsul the Remorseless is a skeletal mage who spawns upon beginning the quest Unexpected Results. He is accompanied by two Angershades. He will, by default, attack the nearest NPC or player upon spawn.
Giant Grizzled Bears are bears located in Silverpine Forest.
The Ghostly Bracers drop from the Tormented Spirit at the Agamand Mills in Tirisfal Glades.
Giant Crocolisk Skin drops from Giant Wetlands Crocolisks in the Wetlands.

__NOTOC__ Ghostlands Guardians are blood elf guards that protect Tranquillien. They either stand guard or patrol the area. Max level versions will spawn if any PvP-enabled NPCs are engaged. When a group of undead from the Dead Scar approach Tranquillien, the guardians respond to their arrival and quickly deal with them. When the Scourge led by Vorath attacked the town after the war against the Jailer, the guardians fought against the undead. Some of them were wounded and tended to by Crusader Dawnheart and Rommath in the main building.
Giant Marsh Frogs are frog critters found around Swamplight Manor in Dustwallow Marsh.
Ghosts of the Past are human ghosts who appear when a piece of Pamela's Doll is approached in Darrowshire in the Eastern Plaguelands.
{{tooltip-wc3 |mode={} |arg={} |name=Ghost Key |icon=INV_Misc_Key_02 |class=Campaign |desc=A ghostly key. }} This key is rather insubstatial.
The Giant Softshell Clam is located in the waters west of Ethel Rethor in Desolace.
Gezzarak's Claws drop from Gezzarak the Huntress in Terokkar Forest.
Giant Eye Tentacles are summoned by C'Thun in the Temple of Ahn'Qiraj.
Ghostblade Post is a small Forsaken outpost located just south of Nifflevar in the Howling Fjord.

Ghost Walker Braves are level 50 Tauren men and women that protect and defend the outpost of Ghost Walker Post located on the northeaster ledge of the Kodo Graveyard in central Desolace, Kalimdor. The guards are equipped with spears and protect the village from Elder Thunder Lizards that roam nearby, the Burning Legion presence in the region, the hostile Centaur clans as well as the Alliance. The braves are located through out the outpost patrolling the pathways and making sure no harm comes to the civilians living in the village. Currently, there are only six Ghost Walker Braves that protect and serve Ghost Walker Post.

Ghostwing is a frost wyrm that appears in Icecrown after completing the quest Killing Two Scourge With One Skeleton. When he appears he flies toward Crusader Olakin Sainrith and proceeds to tear him to pieces, scattering his body parts in the lands below. This opens a new chain starting with He's Gone to Pieces.
__NOTOC__ The Giant Darkwater Clam can be found by fishing in Wintergrasp.
Permanently enchant a melee weapon to have a chance of reducing movement speed and doing additional damage against giants. Requires a level 60 or higher item.
The Giant Sewer Rat is a rat companion pet. True to its name, it is considerably larger than other rats.
Ghastly Haunts are wraiths found at the Broken Stair in Karazhan.
Ghostly Essence drops from the following mobs in Deadwind Pass: *Unliving Caretaker *Damned Soul *Restless Shade *Wailing Spectre
Ghoul Drools are located on the shelves in Finklestein's Laboratory at Heb'Valok in Zul'Drak.
The Ghostly Cooking Fire can be found on the ground near Catrina and Chapman during the Day of the Dead. This fire is specifically required to cook the Bread of the Dead.

On completion of the quest Preparations for the Underworld, one gains the effect The Breath of Har'koa for a short while. Thereafter, upon approaching the Altar of Quetz'lun, the character will gain the buff Ghostly. This is similar to the effect of the Bash'ir Phasing Device, with the world changing to the monotones shown when the character is a ghost. In this form, the character can interact with Quetz'lun's Spirit.
__NOTOC__ Ghostly Priests are high elf ghosts found in Sword's Rest of the Halls of Reflection. They were members of the 1st Legion who accompanied Arthas Menethil in his campaign to Northrend.
The Giant-Sized Laxative is a box found in the second floor of the gnome building on the Ruined Reaches.

__NOTOC__ Ghislania is a naga loyal to Queen Azshara. At some point, she was captured by Spiketooth and forced to fight as a gladiator. When Spiketooth's cart broke down on the eastern coast of Durotar, Spiketooth was able to keep her reined in. While it's unknown how long she has been under Spiketooth's control, he does reveal that Ghislania has lost her last three fights.
A novice mage of the Alliance investigates an outbreak of mana surges in the Blue Recluse tavern.
Ghosts in the Dark is an alliance-only quest achievement earned for completing Writings of the Void, which requires the player to defeat Telarius Voidstrider beneath the Maw of the Void in Darkshore.

Ghaliri is a Zandalari troll quest giver at Fort Livingston in Northern Stranglethorn. He is an emissary of Rastakhan. Although he is affiliated with the neutral Zandalar Tribe, his quests are Alliance-only. During the events of Rise of the Zandalari he vanished from the camp.
Ghostly Spellthread is created with Cataclysm Tailoring (10); taught by trainers.
The Giant Furious Pike is an objective of daily fishing quest A Furious Catch.
Giant Sea Grubs are larvae that crawl on the sea floor at Gorrok's Lament in Vashj'ir.
Giant Claw Tentacles are summoned by C'Thun in the Temple of Ahn'Qiraj.
__NOTOC__ Giant Rabid Bears are black plagued bears found in northern Silverpine Forest.
Giant Driftrays are rays swimming around in packs in the Shimmering Expanse. If you attack one in a pack, they all attack you.
Ghoul Raveners are ghouls found in the Gauntlet in Stratholme.
Ghost Iron Ore is gathered from mining Ghost Iron Deposits (mining skill 515) and Rich Ghost Iron Deposits (mining skill 550) on Pandaria.
Ghostly Marauders are undead centaurs located in the tunnels outside Maraudon in Desolace.
Ghostly Raiders are undead centaur found in the tunnels outside Maraudon in Desolace.
Giant Isopods are critters found in the Shimmering Expanse and the Abyssal Depths.
Ghost-Forged Blade is created with Blacksmithing (545); taught by trainers.
__NOTOC__ Ghost Shard is created with Blacksmithing (545); taught by trainers.
Ghost-Forged Belt is created with Blacksmithing (525); taught by trainers.

Ghost-Forged Boots are created with Blacksmithing (530); taught by trainers.
Ghost-Forged Legplates are created with Blacksmithing (530); taught by trainers.
Ghost-Forged Shoulders are created with Blacksmithing (540); taught by trainers.
Ghost-Forged Breastplate is created with Blacksmithing (550); taught by trainers.
Ghost-Forged Helm is created with Blacksmithing (550); taught by trainers.
Ghost-Forged Bracers come in two varieties; the latter being a random upgrade when crafting the former.
Ghostly Skeleton Keys are created with Blacksmithing (500); taught by trainers.
Ghost Iron Shield Spike is created with Blacksmithing (540); taught by Plans: Ghost Iron Shield Spike.
Ghost Iron Bolts is created with Engineering (500); taught by trainers.
__NOTOC__ The Ghost Iron Staff is created with Inscription (560); taught by trainers.
Ghost Reaver's Breastplate is created with Blacksmithing (600); taught by Plans: Ghost Reaver's Breastplate.

__NOTOC__ Giant Mantis Shrimp is fished from pools along the coasts of Pandaria, including Isle of Thunder and Timeless Isle. It is a cooking ingredient in several recipes, including certain raid feasts and for Shrimp Dumplings which is used to increase reputation with Ella of The Tillers. They can also be purchased from Nam Ironpaw at Halfhill Market in Valley of the Four Winds; one Ironpaw Token purchases a Sack of Giant Mantis Shrimp which contains five of them.

__NOTOC__ Gi-Oh is a pandaren that can be found in two different spots of Honeydew Glade in the Jade Forest: in the first, he's with Ellie Honeypaw and Sue-Ji the Tender, in the second he's with Kai-Lin Honeydew. He was traveling with either Ellie or Kai-Lin to Dawn's Blossom with a cart full of brew barrels, when the Alliance forces of the nearby Thunder Hold started to fight with the Horde crew of the Hellscream's Fist. In both cases, the cart and much of the barrels were broken, and Gi-Oh can be found sobbing for the lost brew. He later helps the player, carrying the recovered barrels during Priorities! (Horde)
Ghost Iron Dragonling is crafted with Pandaria Engineering (25); taught by trainers. It summons a same-named guardian.
Ghost Fox Boots are quest reward from Fires and Fears of Old.

Giant Dinosaur Bones drop from all of the dinosaurs and the Zandalari Dinomancers on the Isle of Giants, off the northern coast of Kun-Lai Summit. Additionally, they can be found in the Shiny Pile of Refuse consolation bag from Oondasta should players fail to win loot from the giant devilsaur. Should you get extra bones that you don't need, you can always list them in the auction house or donate them to your guild bank.
The Ghost Devilsaur Stampede is summoned as part of the Echo of Kros encounter at Ihgaluk Crag on the Isle of Thunder.

Ghost Iron Lockboxes drops randomly from level 85+ mobs. Rogues can also pickpocket them from humanoid mobs. They contain 40-45 gold and an ilevel 416-429 uncommon item; there is a chance that the uncommon item will be another Ghost Iron Lockbox, containing more gold and another item (which can also be another lockbox... and so on and so on).

This is a Trading Card Game item, obtained by the Ghostly Charger card in the expansion "Betrayal of the Guardian." To get your item, first you will need to go to WoW's [http://www.worldofwarcraft.com/misc/promotion.html Promotion Page] and enter in the 25-digit code on your card. This will then give you an in-game code that can be redeemed by Landro Longshot in Booty Bay.
Giant Sack of Coins is rewarded upon completion of specific Brawler's Guild Challenge Card quests: *Grandpa Grumplefloot (quest) *Master Boom Boom (quest) *Ty'thar (quest)

Giant Dinosaur vs. Mega Snail is an achievement that is awarded for opening the Thrice-Locked Cage during the Thok the Bloodthirsty encounter in the Siege of Orgrimmar raid instance and then allow its inhabitant to feast upon Thok's corpse once you have defeated the encounter.
Giant Purse of Timeless Coins is looted from the corpse of Karkanos, rare kraken terrorizing the docks of Old Pi'jiu on Timeless Isle.

Giant Flesh-Eating Tadpoles are tadpoles in Stillwater Pond that have been adversely affected by volatile chemicals dumped in by irresponsible members of the Royal Apothecary Society. Armand Cromwell would like to see these gathered up before they have a chance to grow any further, or so he claims.
Gezzrah is a succubus located at the Lion's Landing in the Krasarang Wilds.

Ghost Truffle was an item which could be gathered from the Ghost Truffle objects, found singly in a variety of locations across Ashran. The Truffles had no intrinsic value, but could be traded to each faction's alchemists - Gimlet Ginfizz for Alliance, Tyra Silverblood for Horde - in exchange for Phantom Potion.
Giant Deathweb Egg is looted from a Curious Deathweb Egg in Talador.
The Giant Coldsnout has a chance to drop from Invader's Forgotten Treasure, Routed Invader's Crate of Spoils or any of the Master and Commander garrison bosses.
__NOTOC__ Giant Skeleton Warriors are skeleton warrior creeps that can be encountered in the Dungeon and Underground tilesets.
__NOTOC__ Gharg is an arena master of the Gorian Empire. He is normally found at the entrance into Highmaul leading heroes to the arena above.

The Ghost Spirit appears in The Fires Down Below, guarding a Ring of Protection +2.
Giant Nagrand Cherries are found in the level 3 garrison Herb Garden randomly. Occasionally when looting these, a Perfect Nagrand Cherry may drop.
